item: Video length is min 40 seconds – maximum 1 minute
English subtitles need to be included, mandatory if voiceover is not in English.
Overall clinic experience need to be covered: facility + treatment process
Consultation scene need to be included
Procedure scene need to be included
Before & After need to be shown
Personal review / reaction need to be included
Transparent pricing need to be mentioned
Personalized consultation need to be highlighted
Doctor's expertise and aesthetic sense need to be highlighted
Smooth communication / translation need to be highlighted
Friendly staff need to be mentioned
Any sensitive scenes (e.g. needle insertion) need to be blurred or mosaicked
Required hashtags need to be included: #upicclinic #upicclinicmyeongdong #kbeauty
TikTok Tag need to be active (cliickable). The current one is a plain text which is not connected / clickable.
